observationsNotFindings.observation: leftoverDesignRemainingOnDR105 now carries OBL-R10-AUTHORING and OBL-R6-AUTHORING. Measured across the repository, both identifiers occur in exactly one file — this subject. They are absent from permission-leftover-join.v2, from file 08 and from COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md. The live D-163 measurement records a seven-member leftoverDesign set; this artifact's partition of one closed plus eight remaining yields nine.
observationsNotFindings.whyNotCharged: This is the mechanism by which CLAUDE-G09H-V2-SF1 was remedied, and the remedy this reviewer named was to record that the R-10 and R-6 authoring 'remains leftover on DR-105 beyond OBL-FX-AUTHORING's fourteen'. The subject does exactly that and discloses the delta in substance: noteOnOblFxAuthoring pins what is recorded ('OBL-FX-AUTHORING remains the D-163 fourteen') and separates what is not ('R-10 and R-6 authoring is leftover on DR-105 beyond that fourteen'), while proposedLaterWork routes both byte-sets to a later D-000 cycle rather than asserting either as already recorded. The artifact binds NOTHING and is CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED at DO-NOT-SEAL, so it proposes rather than applies. Charging the identifiers after charging their absence would make the finding unsatisfiable by any means — name the work and be charged for minting, or leave it unnamed and be charged for the gap — and this reviewer will not move the standard that way. Naming genuinely required unowned work is the honest direction.
observationsNotFindings.forTheCoordinator: Recording this artifact would introduce two obligation identifiers that no prior D-000 cycle measured. Whether DR-105's leftover-design inventory is amended by a harness specification or by a successor to the D-163 leftover-design measurement is a recording-act question for the coordinator, not a defect in this specification. Flagged so the recording act is taken with that fact in view.
